experiment_text: All 60 new historical candidates completed, across 180 frozen fit/cohort checks and 120 annual evaluations. None of the 60 native candidates beats the preserved best on the 9 exact pooled comparisons. Separately, the historical total-MAE shadow role improved from 10.342478 to 10.320930 points on the verified same 570-game, one-hour 2024/2025 cohort, a 0.021547-point difference. This is exposed development evidence, not an independent prospective improvement or production promotion. No direct paired uncertainty interval against the former total-MAE champion is available. None of the 633 saved clustered reference comparisons passed Holm-adjusted p<0.05, so no statistically established improvement is claimed. Other primary historical metric selections remain unchanged. The combined historical ledger preserves 1,320 cards, including 48 authentic N082 cards omitted from the N083 current table; those recovered cards earn no new fit credit.

performance_text: 43.208 minutes before packaging; another 67.126 seconds of pre-ZIP packaging and ZIP finalization are excluded. Five actual native optimizer calls overlapped. The 180 new historical fits completed their optimizer window in 31.898 seconds (5.643 fits/second within that window); a 30.040-second interior process-tree window consumed 197.47 CPU-seconds, averaging 6.574 cores. Whole-invocation mean: 1.361 cores. A retained 11.636-core sample coincided with actual fits; neither this sample nor the nominal 12-worker lease proves sustained twelve-core fitting. First real fit: 201.258 seconds; diagnostic escalation: 122.313 seconds. Warm archive batch: 3.801 seconds for two items. Scoped source-cache reuse: 465 hits / 1,437 misses, 319,538,090 reused bytes, 68.67% by bytes; its two S3 GETs are not the complete transport census. Whole-instance compute estimate $1.851, excluding packaging, storage and provider costs; 15 paid calls. Different workloads prevent a matched end-to-end speedup claim.
